definition: טַבּוּר noun [masculine] highest part, centre (according to ᵐ5 ᵑ9 navel , so Late Hebrew id. , and טִיבּוּר , Aramaic טִיבּוּרָא , טִיבּוּרְיָא ) — הִנֵּה עָם יֹרְדִים מֵעִם טַבּוּר הארץ Judg 9:37 behold people descending from the highest part of the land ; ישְׁבֵי עַלטַֿבּוּר הארץ Ezek 38:12 those dwelling upon the navel of the earth , i.e. upon the mountainous country of Israel, central and prominent in the earth.
